name: Payzec Gateway
author: Payzec

sections.description:
Payzec for WooCommerce is a powerful plugin that enables seamless integration of the Payzec payment gateway with WooCommerce. It allows store owners to securely process payments using Payzec’s token validation system, supports multiple currencies, and provides detailed logs for transaction audits.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL v2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the payzec-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce -> Settings -> Payments and configure the Payzec settings.
sections.faq:
How do I get my Payzec API credentials?

You can obtain your API credentials by logging into your Payzec account and navigating to the API section.

Can I use this plugin with any WooCommerce theme?

Yes, Payzec for WooCommerce is designed to work with any WooCommerce-compatible theme.
